title: Prior-Drop Reduction Schedule, Cartwise Shopper Contractor Accounts
content:
**Clause.** In a dropped-batch dispute on a Cartwise Shopper Contractor Accounts account, the prior-drop reduction counts the other dropped-batch violations recorded on the account less than twelve whole months before the dispute, the disputed one not counted: 2 or more take off 2 points; exactly one takes off 1 point; none takes off nothing.

| Other dropped-batch violations in the twelve months before the dispute | Prior-drop reduction |
|---|---|
| 2 or more | 2 points |
| Exactly 1 | 1 point |
| None | Nothing |

## Counting (hypothetical accounts)

| Dropped-batch violations in the twelve months, the disputed one included | Others | Reduction |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | 0 | Nothing |
| 2 | 1 | 1 point |
| 3 | 2 | 2 points |

Only dropped-batch violations are counted. A dropped-batch violation recorded thirteen months before the dispute is outside the twelve months.
